History Of The Geyser


Lord Morbius,  The Acid Claw Brigade has just completed our investigation on the relic known as "The Geyser" and I have good news.  We have managed to locate the relic and now have it in our possession.

I sent this communique ahead to inform  you of our impending arrival.  I would like to tell you how we came to be in possession of the relic as its true origins as best as I can guess.  This information may be of some interest to you.

As you have foretold, the relic was indeed found in a very remote section of the underworld.  We battled many large beasts of a terrible nature to obtain the relic.

In doing so we lost many good compatriots but that is of little concern to one such as you.

It would seem that "The Geyser" is not a thing of nature or of any magic of the Realmz.  As far as I can tell, it's not even a thing of the Realmz at all.  I can only describe it as some form of strange device created by beings from another world beyond the stars.

We tracked the device to a small round craft lodged in the side of an immense cavern.  About the craft were many creatures that I have never seen nor heard tales of before.

It was a mighty battle but we managed to defeat the creatures.  A few of the beasts were humanoid in form but appeared to have been made from metal.  They carried strange weapons that shot beams of light.

We lost nearly three full companies of our best men before we could overwhelm them.  We are bringing back some of these light weapons along with 'The Geyser' for you to examine.

As per our agreement we were promised a large sum of wealth for the return of the relic and we would be pleased if you could have the payment ready when we arrive.

Some of our men have been disappearing each time we make camp.  Something is following us and I would not be surprised if it was the original owner of the relic.  I am sure it would be no match for one of your powers but we seem to be nothing more than prey in its eyes.

By the time this message reaches you we should be no more than a few days in reaching you.

Your Servant

Captain Gail Wyrmrider
12th Acid Claw Brigade

The tale I am about to tell you has its roots from even before I was born.

Many years agone, some 430 years to be exact a great evil was perpetrated upon a young mage by the name of Weston Forthsun.  Young Weston is human yet he still lives to this day.  Though he is very ancient in both years and looks his life has been extended by his own hand using the most powerful of magics.

Some 430 years ago Weston was a budding mage of high promise.  His mentor was a powerful mage known as Glamvil Goldwedge.  Weston was a good pupil but had a more than average curiosity. Many years of study made Weston impatient to learn the more powerful secrets of his master.

Then came a time when his master was off on some unknown errand.  Weston stole into his masters? private chambers.  It was not an attempt to outright steel the secrets hi coveted so highly, he just hoped for a taste of what was to come in later years.

Unknown to Weston however, magical wards his master placed upon his most prized tombs allowed Glamvil to know of Weston?s visit. As all mages know, an intrusion into the private chambers of a master by ones apprentice is not unheard of but it's a serious offense none the less.

Glamvil was furious with Weston. Tempers began to flare as both men let their emotions gain the upper hand.  Normally mages are calm and calculating folk but unknown to Weston at the time is that his master was suffering from a spiritual possession from his recent trip. The nature of this possession is how our clan has come to be involved in this affair but I will explain that later.

During the argument between Weston and Glamvil, Glamvil cast a spell upon Weston.  At first the spell did not seem to have any effect.  Weston managed to escape the confines of his master?s tower only to return months later when his former master summoned him.

Glamvil fought the spirit that had possessed him for a number of months before finally winning the battle and exorcising his tormentor.  Glamvil made it clear to Weston that he was not happy with his infraction but the reason for summoning him back as his apprentice was for a far more serious reason.  It became clear to Glamvil that the spell cast upon Weston was one of the most powerful and evil sorts.  A sort that he himself did not know how to counter. The spell was cast by Glamvil but knowledge of the spell originated from the spirit that possessed him at the time if its casting.

The spell is known as "Shadow Phase".  The result of such a spell is to curse the victim to an eternal life as a Litch upon his death. For nearly 40 years Glamvil and Weston attempted to find a counterspell to remove the curse from Weston but they had never found one.

Glamvil died and Weston was left on his own to find a way out of his eventual fate. As Weston grew in years his powers as a mage grew rapidly.  In his quest to find a counterspell he gained much knowledge.  He discovered many ways both natural and magical to extend his life.  All in an attempt to avoid seeing his fate come to pass. Weston has never found a counterspell to rid him of his curse but has managed to find the next best thing.

Though he can't prevent himself from changing to a Litch upon his death he has found a way to imprison himself and thus preventing him from harming others. Weston is a man of a good heart and does not desire to have his very soul corrupted by the transformation to a Litch.  Nor does he relish the thought of his Litch form causing pain and suffering to innocents for an eternity.

Now however, he feels he has found a solution.  If he can but imprison himself in a vault designed to contain his Litch form he can spend eternity safe from the evil he would visit upon mortals. Building this vault is now the task set before us.

Our beloved former King Raggwine, slain by shadow elves some 430 years past may be the very source of this foul curse. The soul of King Raggwine did not journey beyond as one would have hoped but roamed the Realmz in search of a way to avenge his death upon his slayers.  It was the soul of Raggwine himself that possessed Glamvil and was the one who cast the curse upon Weston.  Raggwine took control of Glamvil in hopes of using his magical powers to defeat his shadow elf slayers.

However, Raggwines spirit was corrupted in the possession and the end result was madness. Before Glamvil could rid himself of our former kings insane soul the damage had been done and Weston found himself with this evil curse.  As it was our former king?s soul that started this evil, it's our duty as his descendants to help in any way we can. As such we have pledged ourselves to help construct this Mithril Vault.

It's the construction of this vault that has our entire clan in such disarray and is the true cause of your mithril gone missing. The vault must be of a spherical shape with an outside diameter of 300 hands and walls no less than 30 hands thick. Needless to say that will take an outrageous amount of mithril to construct. The sheer amount of mithril required has proved to be the largest problem.  Even with all our reserves and all our mining crews working around the clock we estimate that we will fall far short of the amount needed.

Weston has divined that he has but a few short months yet to live and we have little hope of gathering enough mithril by that time to construct the mithril vault. As grim as my tale may sound there is hope.  Even now I await Westons arrival as he claims he may have the solution to our dilemma.

They grow ever more suspicious of my true nature.  The queen herself has begun to view me as a monster in disguise.  After all the years of loyalty they would not cast me off like an old boot.

The king himself has begun to whisper behind my back.  The fool.  It is he that has asked me to hone my skills as a vision stealer for his own use.  If the rest of the royal court new how it was he that claimed the throne with my aid he would be hanged.  Now he is looking to tie up loose ends at my expense.

Perhaps it is he that will rue the day I discovered my hidden talent.  For now I keep my peace as I know he has spies and assassins at his command that would slay me before I could make my move.

Perhaps I shall just leave one day and never look back.  I hear tell of a peaceful town some 300 leagues east called Winterhaven.  Their I could start a new life as a simple merchant in search of a fat profit and an even fatter wife.  Perhaps... Perhaps...

The head magistrate relates to you this tale.

Our city has lived in peace for so long few can remember when times were tough.  Our whole economy and welfare rests on the fair trade with the Dwarven clans to the east in the silver mountains.

Mithril has always flowed from the mines and we have always been on good terms with the Dwarven leadership.  However, things have taken a drastic turn for the worse.

It is common knowledge in the city of our trip to meet with the Dwarven king so I will touch on that briefly.  As you probably know, we met with the Dwarven king in order to find out why the flow of Mithril has stopped.  His answer did not sit well with us and was an obvious fabrication.  We even went as far as to cast a few magical spells and they confirmed that he was not telling us the whole truth.

All further attempts to meet with the clan leaders has met with stiff resistance or outright refusal.

What we need of you is for you to investigate the situation and find out the truth as to why the Mithril has stopped flowing.

Already sign of decay have started to appear and people begin to whisper of leaving for greener pastures.

To make matters worse, many of the races that live within Silver Peak are finding the Dwarves belligerent.  The Dwarven armies are attempting to keep any outsiders away from the mines.

With the increased tension some of the creatures native to Silver Peak are finding it difficult to hunt and survive and have began to raid outlying farming communities.

We must find out the truth behind this mysterious turn of events and set it right at any cost.

Sir Maxwell:

Our lord and master has instructed all members of the Circle of Blood to step up their investigations.  He grows weary of life in the Realmz.  His impatience can only mean ultimate pain and suffering for those of the Circle.

It is imperative that you find out who is behind the theft of the Geyser Stone.  Even as I write this he has begun to devour the minds of more than a dozen slaves.  From what I can tell he will need the energy in order to extract the most hideous of tortures upon a fellow member of the Circle of Blood.  I can only pray that it's not I that has displeased him.

For the love of all that is holy, find out what has become of the Geyser Stone.  My minions have captured and tortured a trio of Harpies.  Before their deaths they said something strange.  They kept mumbling about the dwarves and how they were attacking anything that came near the Mithril Mines with such ferocity that no creatures dared go near them.

This is odd indeed for the Dwarven clans seem to live in relative peace with all.  It's my believe they may know something of the Geyser Stone.  They have a vast network of informers and seem to know something of everything that happens in the dark recesses of Silver Peak.

Our need of information on the whereabouts of the Geyser Stone is so great that I fear you must risk using your natural talents to give us some clue.  The master grows ever so impatient and every member of the circle knows what that can mean.

I only wish he would go back from whence he came.  Though I know not for certain where that may be I have heard that he hails from a body from beyond the stars.  How that can be I do not know but I quiver at the thought of the power he must have in order to travel the heavens as would a god.

Mentat Volbilove
Circle of Blood
7th Ring 4th Quadrant
